title.en: Launch adaptive AI learning media and real-life speaking
title.zh: 上线自适应 AI 学习媒体与真实生活口语体验

purpose.en: Make beginner learning visual, practical, and consistently graded while keeping every generated sentence inside the learner’s current and previously learned vocabulary.
purpose.zh: 让初级学习更直观、更实用且难度稳定，并确保每个生成句子只使用本轮及此前已经学过的词汇。

en: Generate and record an original AI beginner picture-choice sprite for sixteen high-frequency concrete concepts.
Use GPT-5.6 Luna to create release-versioned reading, listening, writing, and dialogue sentences from cumulative learned vocabulary, with D1 caching and a safe fallback.
Expand all twelve Everyday Speaking places to beginner, intermediate, and advanced real-person role-play with useful scene vocabulary.
Make three scored follow-me attempts optional and off by default across Sprint, SmartCard, course vocabulary, and Everyday Speaking.
Auto-score selections immediately, reserve Continue for reviewed feedback, and keep SmartCard Challenge on its six-second timed advance.
zh: 为十六个高频具体概念生成并登记 SmartLingo 原创 AI 初级看图选择素材。
使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 仅基于累积已学词汇生成阅读、听力、写作和对话句子，按发布版本写入 D1 缓存并提供安全降级。
将十二个生活口语地点扩展为初级、中级、高级真人角色对话，并加入实用场景词汇。
今日速成、智慧卡、课程词汇与生活口语的三次评分跟读均改为可选且默认关闭。
选择后立即判定，继续按钮只出现在反馈复习页；智慧卡挑战继续六秒自动前进。

en: Anonymous Play, Today’s Sprint, SmartCard practice and Challenge, Beginner course vocabulary, course sentence practice, Everyday Speaking, D1 migrations, and Cloudflare deployment workflow
zh: 匿名边玩边学、今日速成、智慧卡练习与挑战、初级课程词汇、课程组句、生活口语、D1 迁移及 Cloudflare 发布工作流

en: Anonymous Play activities no longer reuse a target-language selection; each tile asks again.
A new anonymous Sprint cookie is overwritten on each fresh entry and updated during the active session, while member progress continues to resume from D1.
Vocabulary remains sorted by lowest difficulty and then highest frequency, with both metrics visible.
Every Cloudflare deployment stamps a new adaptive-content release ID after Worker deployment so stale sentence sets regenerate.
zh: 匿名边玩边学的各入口不再共用学习语言，每个卡片都重新选择。
匿名今日速成每次新进入都会覆盖短期 Cookie，当前学习过程中持续更新；会员进度仍从 D1 继续。
词汇继续按最低难度、同级最高常用度排序，并显示两项指标。
每次 Cloudflare 发布在 Worker 部署后写入新的自适应内容版本号，让旧句子缓存自动重新生成。

en: Vinext production build, TypeScript checking, and all 348 automated tests passed with zero failures.
All 57 tracked migrations apply once and no-op on rerun; sensitive-data scan, artifact validation, and diff checks passed.
Production browser acceptance will cover Chinese-to-Japanese and English-to-Italian flows after GitHub Actions deploys to Cloudflare.
zh: Vinext 生产构建、TypeScript 类型检查及全部 348 项自动化测试通过，失败为零。
全部 57 个受跟踪迁移首次执行成功且再次执行无变化；敏感信息扫描、构建产物验证与差异检查通过。
GitHub Actions 发布到 Cloudflare 后，将以中文学日语和英文学意大利语完成生产浏览器验收。

en: Provider-hosted short video remains a future media upgrade; the current release uses scenario-matched real-person imagery with code-driven camera motion and an accessible still fallback.
zh: 外部服务托管的短视频保留为后续媒体升级；本次采用场景匹配的真人图片、代码驱动镜头运动及无障碍静态降级。

en: Use original SmartLingo learning media and interaction patterns without copying Duolingo characters, brand assets, or protected presentation.
Preserve Clerk, Cloudflare, governed AI gateway, commerce, course pricing, and site-owned data boundaries.
zh: 使用 SmartLingo 原创学习媒体与交互方式，不复制 Duolingo 角色、品牌素材或受保护呈现。
保持 Clerk、Cloudflare、受治理 AI 网关、商业、课程定价与站点自有数据边界。
